name: DataPocket – Design in Canva, Figma & Adobe using your Woo & WordPress data
author: OVIXIA

sections.description:
Revolutionize your design workflow with real-time data import

DataPocket is the ultimate WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for designers, marketers, and eCommerce store owners. Connect with Canva, Figma, Adobe Express, and the full Adobe Suite, allowing you to automatically pull live product data —including images, descriptions, and prices— directly into your design projects. No more manual copying and pasting—just real-time content updates that keep your designs fresh, accurate, and efficient.

Watch How It Works

Usage Video WooCommerce

Usage Video WordPress

Features & Benefits

  • Live Data Integration – Pull real-time data from WordPress and WooCommerce directly into Canva, Figma, Adobe Express, and Adobe Suite.
  • Automatic content sync – Instantly add product images, descriptions, and pricing to your designs.
  • Faster workflows – Eliminate tedious manual updates and speed up your content creation process.
  • Easier collaboration – Enable seamless collaboration with your team, clients, and stakeholders.
  • One-way sync – Ensures clean, structured data flow from WordPress/WooCommerce to design tools.

Perfect for These Use Cases

  • eCommerce & Marketing – Design product catalogs, social media posts, banners, and ads with real-time WooCommerce data.
  • Website mockups – Build realistic prototypes with live WordPress page and post content.
  • Content creation – Quickly generate blog visuals, newsletters, and digital assets without copying text manually.

Why choose DataPocket?

Save Hours on design & updates
Reduce errors & maintain accuracy
Effortless setup – No coding required

Start designing smarter today! 🚀

About Us

This plugin is proudly developed by OVIXIA, bringing real-time content automation to your favorite design tools.

Design in Canva, Figma & Adobe using your WooCommerce & WordPress data – effortlessly!
